title: Android 版本演进中的内存变化：5.0 到 17
key_conclusions: Android version, target SDK, kernel version, ROM, and build type are part of every memory conclusion.
Android 10 and 11 are major lmkd boundaries because PSI mode and the newer PSI/thrashing strategy change diagnosis.
Android 17 adds app memory limits and memory-limiter diagnostics that must be checked when sessions are terminated.
AOSP source paths from Day 74 only become evidence when tied to a specific branch or device build.
shallow_points: The version matrix is diagnostic and does not validate every row against a local AOSP checkout.
Several Android 12 through 16 entries remain high-level because exact defaults vary by device, kernel, and ROM.
The article cites official Android pages for Android 10, 11, and 17 but does not include full source diffs.
It does not include real ApplicationExitInfo or memory-limiter output from an Android 17 device.
discovered_connections: Day 74's branch/version/source-boundary discipline becomes the central rule for reading version evolution.
Day 73's observe-attribute-intervene-validate loop remains the migration checklist for every version jump.
Day 72's build-to-runtime boundary matters more on Android 17 because app memory limits require runtime evidence, not APK-size assumptions.
Day 76 should convert this version-aware evidence model into interview answers for GC, leaks, OOM, and Native memory.
suggest_future_topics: Day 76 should focus on interview questions for GC, leaks, OOM, and Native memory using evidence-first answers.
A future appendix should validate Android 5.0 through 17 rows against AOSP release notes and source tags.
A future lab should collect ApplicationExitInfo and memory-limiter output on Android 17.
A future article should compare MessageQueue behavior and Handler leak reasoning before and after Android 17 target SDK 37.
knowledge_gaps: Need local AOSP tags and kernel configs to verify exact feature defaults across versions.
Need real Android 17 device output for memory limiter status, manual limits, and trigger-based heap dumps.
Need source-backed details for Android 12 through 16 memory-related changes by device class.
Need measured migration cases showing how the same app behaves across Android 10, 11, 14, and 17.
applied_reflections: Applied Day 74's next-run instruction by focusing on Android version evolution from 5.0 to 17.
Applied Day 74's branch/version/source-boundary discipline by requiring API level, target SDK, kernel version, ROM, build type, and AOSP tag before claiming defaults.
Applied Day 73's evidence-to-source loop by making version migration a sequence of symptom evidence, tool support, system capability, and source branch validation.
Applied the standing more-diagrams-less-prose feedback by using four Mermaid diagrams, version matrices, official-source anchors, command templates, and migration checklists.
visible_changes: Added four Mermaid diagrams because of the more-diagrams-less-prose feedback: version timeline, version-boundary decision flow, evidence/version sequence, and Android 17 memory-limiter troubleshooting flow.
Added tables for version stages, non-mixable defaults, Android 5.0-17 matrix, official anchors, evidence changes, Android 17 acceptance signals, and engineering conclusions.
Added Android 17 `am memory-limiter` command templates and explicit `ApplicationExitInfo` checks.
